_comment: Skills that breach a structural budget TODAY (issue #1616). A waiver is a DEBT RECORD, not a
dispensation: it freezes the breach at the size it was on the day it was written and names who
fixes it. Three ratchets in tests/test_skill_structure.py stop it becoming permanent scenery —
(1) a waived skill may never EXCEED its recorded numbers, so the +51%-in-10-days growth that
made #1611 worse between filing and fixing now turns CI red instead of going unnoticed;
The 2026-09-17 description trim moved selection detail into linked references and lowered
the two recorded token ceilings without raising their line ceilings; the debt remains.
(2) a waiver whose skill is back inside every budget is a FAILURE, so the entry must be deleted
the moment the fix lands, rather than sitting here forever; (3) the number of entries is capped
by a test, so a new breach cannot be absorbed by quietly adding a third line here.
To retire one: shrink the skill, then delete its entry. To raise a ceiling: you must edit the
number below, which shows up as a diff line in your PR and has to be argued there.
'recorded' fields are as measured by evals/skill_structure.py on 2026-09-03 (chars/4 estimator
— see that file's docstring for its calibration against a real tokenizer). Only fields that
actually breach are recorded; the gate compares field-by-field.
